title: WaterSound Crossings A-317 - 429 Bridge Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Great views of the Gulf and natural dunes- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella (Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31)- Pool and beach are just yards away- Professionally decorated- Fantastic porch spaces- Free WiFi- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*The property does not come with dedicated parking spaces, however, 2 vehicles can enter the community for the opportunity to park in the first come first serve parking. Please note first come first serve parking is limited and not guaranteed. This condo permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.*Beginning in March 2025 and continuing through 2026, the WaterSound Crossings condominiums will undergo an extensive exterior refurbishment project. During this period, residents and guests should expect significant construction activity, including the boarding of windows and restricted access to balconies in affected buildings. These measures are necessary to ensure safety and facilitate the successful completion of the work.DETAILS: WaterSound Crossings unit A-317 has 3 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and sleeps 8. Guests will enjoy breathtaking views of undisturbed dunes, elevated boardwalks, and the Gulf from a luxuriously large balcony. Pool and beach access are steps away.Colorful art and a unique chandelier greet guests in the entryway, setting the tone for the plush decor and finishes within. A kitchen with premium appliances, including a wine chiller, beautiful white and gray tile backsplashes, and a kitchen island with a farmhouse-style sink overlooks a posh living and dining area with spectacular Gulf views. Rich jewel tones, textured finishes, and colorful modern art add depth to the comfortable room. A dining table with seating for 6 is lit by a starburst-style chandelier and enjoys Gulf views through a wall of windows and glass doors that open onto the spacious balcony. From the balcony, guests will marvel at the dune and beach views. It's like looking out onto a private nature reserve! Elevated boardwalks crisscross the dunes and lead to a white sand beach. On the balcony, a custom table with seating for 6 and a table for 4 surround several lounge chairs, creating the ultimate spot to toast the sunset. A guest bedroom with a queen bed has a door that opens onto the balcony and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. A second guest bedroom has a twin-over-twin bunk bed, a queen bed, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. On the opposite side of the living and dining area is the primary bedroom and bathroom. A glass door from the bedroom opens onto the balcony. A king bed enjoys undisturbed views of the dunes and beach through 5 windows that jut outward, adding a slight U-shape to the room and creating an ideal spot to sit and relax. The attached bathroom's white marble floor and counters sparkle in the light from a coral-inspired chandelier above a soaking tub with jets. A separate shower has a glass enclosure.Guests will enjoy the posh finishes, incredible views, and access to the pool and beach, WaterSound Crossings A-317 will book quickly. Call today to secure your dream vacation.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 8) FIRST FLOOR: - Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub Separate - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed and Queen Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
